lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in roughly vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank. These clusters form a semi-regular grid pattern with primary nodes exhibiting peak pixel intensity posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that align with and intersect the primary high-luminance blobs, forming a clear grid-like architecture on the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal linear ridges visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition from high-luminance upper edges to shadow-defined lower edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 10-12 discernible high-luminance spots, though they exhibit lower edge-contrast due to distance and water turbidity relative to the foreground flank features.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible morphological transition in patterning from small, high-density spotting in the anterior region to larger, grid-aligned blobs in the posterior-lateral region.
